first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for No. 42 Northernhay Street, Exeter. The Exeter City Council-hosted Historic Environment Desk-Based Assessment identifies No. 42 Northernhay as a Grade II listed town house and includes an impact-plan figure, but the selected PDF record exposes no reusable coordinate geometry/WKT/GeoJSON for the building footprint; the figure image could not be retrieved for geometry extraction, so no footprint was inferred or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
